name: dftracer_provenance_discover
description: dftracer provenance mode, discovery and agreement stage: after the plain (un-instrumented) run, inventory the outputs, name the scientific-artifact candidates, map every code point that accesses, stores, communicates or computes data, ask the user, then persist the agreed entity spec (provenance/spec.yaml) and validate it. Load for any 'capture provenance / lineage' request, before annotation, or when provenance_write_spec says 'spec failed validation', 'scientific_artifacts is empty', 'id_scheme missing', 'role must be input | output | intermediate', 'description missing or too short', 'participates in no activity (orphan)', 'is generated by no activity'.
